description: Batch output status for one to 25 unique Bitcoin outpoints (txid:vout pairs). Reports this node's chainstate and sequential mempool observations, value, script, confirmations and coinbase flag. Missing does not prove spent. No cryptographic unspentness proof or spendability guarantee; all-absent batches rejected before charging. Price: 20 sats or US$0.02 (USDC) per call.

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

outpoints.description: One to 25 unique comma-separated txid:vout pairs. txid is 64 hex characters; vout 0..65535. URLs disclose these public outpoints to Diamond.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.

name: check_outputs
title: Batch Bitcoin output status
